comparison: fused random forest minus cyber-only random forest
full_test_resampling: paired event bootstrap stratified by class; positive and negative event counts are preserved in every replicate
matched_resampling: paired bootstrap over matched-pair identifiers; both members of each sampled pair are retained together

thresholds.selection_policy: maximize F1; tie by higher recall then lower threshold

interpretation_boundary: Intervals quantify uncertainty for the frozen leakage-safe controlled-replay test events. They do not imply causal or site-coincident aircraft-cyber detection.
